Under the Hood

3. Unpacks game_en.exe if it exists
4. Points nwjs, mkxp-z, or EasyRPG to directory
5. Launches game

issue

You have 2 options (I recommend the first one):
1.
Go to the folder where the game files are stored, open up the file Game.ini with a text editor and add the following line to the bottom:
RTP=RPGVXAce
Then give it a minute to load everything when it's starting.
2.
Open up the advanced settings and set rgssVersion to 3

There are a few possible things that may be going on.
1. NWJS version issue: Try using 0.43 or older

I can't help you if it's number 3

I always wonder why rpgmaker series engine do have macos version on steam etc, but still a lot of games based on them do not support macos, now, there's no need wondering any more.

Click to expand...
TLDR: Maybe in
Xenolauncher
:
https://github.com/m5kro/Xenolauncher
. However, it's going to take a while.
Action game MV and its predecessor, Pixel Game Maker MV, are kind of weird in the RPG maker lineup. Very few developers actually used PGMMV since regular MV and MZ are way better. There was some support for it on the Nintendo switch, but apart from that, there isn't much cross compatibility. Some people have made an open source launcher:
https://github.com/GGGweb-adm/PGMMV
, but it may take some work to get it working, and it doesn't support encrypted assets.
On the other hand, Action Game Maker MV is just a reskin of Godot 2D, so getting it to work on Mac "should" be relatively easy. Godot support is already planned for Xenolauncher, so I'll release it there.

If this method does not work, then the game isn't packaged with Enigma VB, or it isn't an RPG Maker game.
